notes.title: #HardcoreChallenge $5,000+ Contest Announced!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31200120/9898eedb1c58970769999e305492d60ddea3416d.png[/img]

We've released an update with the new Hardcore Challenge mode!  How far can you take Carthage in 1 hour with your wits, reflexes, and home-brew skillset?  Now is the time to practice up, because the Loot Run #HardcoreChallenge Contest begins June 1st, and the pot begins at $5,000!

Depending on the Steam sales of Loot Run through the end of June, that pot could grow MUCH higher, because we're giving away 10% of our initial earnings for the contest!

Find the official contest rules at www.threeguysgamestudio.com, no purchase necessary.

notes.title: Recent Build Update
notes.content:
I've just pushed out an update that adds a rough 'Speed Run' mode which unlocks upon beating the game.

Also Hard Core Mode now allows for players to access the Hero, Gear, and Skills screen from camp in between any stage, not just after boss fights.  This will allow more down time as well as the ability to spec out for individual stages and bosses rather than needing to do so from the beginning of a zone.

You still won't be able to head back to camp in the middle of a stage in Hard Core Mode - this is intended.
